title: H1 2025 capacity/quota incidents rollup (working)
linked_artifacts: Confluence: Incident Review Summary (H1 2025): Capacity & quota exhaustion incidents  paging and ownership gaps
body:
Working doc for incident review meeting. Not canonical, but used to sanity check completeness.

Incidents (draft list):
- INC-2025-0112 (Hosted API us-east) — GPU pool capacity exhaustion. Owner: Eng Infra. Artifact: postmortem.
- INC-2025-0217 (Console/Rollouts) — quota prevented canary capacity add during rollout. Owner: Eng Platform. Artifact: INT-489 + Slack.
- INC-2025-0303 (Dedicated eu-west) — provisioning blocked by quota + autoscaler lag. Owner: Eng SRE. Artifact: postmortem.
- INC-2025-0411 (Hosted burst pool) — confirmed quota exhaustion after initial runtime-memory hypothesis. Owner: Eng Serving Runtime. Artifact: INT-556.
- INC-2025-0522 (Private VPC) — effective capacity drop from GPU fragmentation. Owner: Eng Infra. Artifact: postmortem.

Notes:
- Need to be careful not to double count tickets vs incidents. Use incident ID as unit.
- Ask Eng Platform to confirm whether INC-2025-0217 should be classified as prod incident (customer impact yes; short duration).
